transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, this is Dave. How can I help you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Dave. I'm trying to pay my bill online and the payment page keeps saying card declined, but my bank says there's no problem with the card. It's getting a bit much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's frustrating when the bank says the card's fine. Let's take a look. Can I take your PIN, please?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Ezra. So the bill payment page keeps declining your card, even though your bank says the card is fine. Is that correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the billing postcode you're typing in the same as the one your bank has for the card?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I think so. I moved last year though.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello? Are you there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. Which postcode are you entering on the page?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: M14 5AB, my current one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And did you update your address with the bank when you moved?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I'm not sure I did, actually.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, the bank's security check compares the postcode. Put your old postcode in the billing field and try again.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where's the billing field? I can't see it.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Like I said, it's on the screen in front of you, it's not hard. It's the box under the card number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. Found it. Old postcode in. Paying now. It says payment successful.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good. Can you check the account balance shows zero now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, balance is zero.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so the bill is paid. Anything else, Ezra?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Bye.
